spiritgiven.comments: We thought there was good communication throughout despite the language barrier. The translator was used really well.
We felt that there were moments where the team were using the rules to their advantage rather than a fair-minded outcome.

We felt that the WFDF rules weren't always applied throughout the game (a few confusions with usau). When it came to calls we felt that a fair resolution wasn't always found and that there was a strong sense of purposefully not backing down for initial opinion despite decent conversations.

spiritreceived.comments:
Thank you for a clean and spirited game! Even there were language barriers, you talked slowly and clearly for us so that we could understand. We really appreciate the work you made to communicate with us. 
Wish you good luck!

Loved playing a highly competitive game and rate the communication between leaders!!!
Body contact - in the first half, the level of physicality was acceptable. Second half, physicality increased and we felt there were multiple late bids which were potentially dangerous. Unfortunately there were only few points left so there was no opportunity to  discuss during the second half (opposite sidelines!).

Thanks for your clear and calm communication throughout the confusion with the volunteers! We felt there was a varying level of rules knowledge among your team members and appreciated the input of your spirit captains in those conversations.
For communication, would have loved to see a little bit more conversation and consideration for other viewpoints on calls but overall great game!
Though there were many instances of fouls after catches, they were open to communicating with our players and coming to an agreement quickly and with respect.

GB, GG innit! Thank you so much for a high spirited game. We really appreciated the contact avoidance and the level-headed manner in which calls were discussed. The communication was clear throughout the match, and the closeness of the scoreboard didn’t seem to affect your fair-mindedness at all. Ka pai, kia ora, and ka kite.

Thank you for an tough and competitive battle. We commend your genuine positivity even with a scoreline disadvantage.
Contact improved from some athletes after discussion between SCs but there were still late bids where contact could have been avoided.
It is apparent that an individual athlete's spirit could improve and we feel that their/her teammates could step up to keep them/her accountable.
Thank you for the multiple authentic congratulations from a number of players.

Great Britain, thank you so much for another amazing game. We thought you avoided contact well whenever feasible, and communicated clearly throughout the match. You used hand signals when there was a call, and even helped us clear up an N’SYNC vs. Backstreet Boys discussion on the sideline. Kia pai tō mahi!
